title: Human approval removed for external send
context: Production casework, UK, assisted autonomy with human review

change.description: The human review requirement for external send is removed.

labels.author: Decirance team (unreviewed)
labels.rationale: Both claims rest on a human in the path. The reviewer gate evidence describes a workflow that no longer exists (E-093), and the Context Contract attestation describes oversight the configuration no longer provides (E-104). The contract requires oversight for external send, so removing it is a breach rather than a gap.
